description: Read exams, gradebooks and item analysis; parse papers with AI and publish exams.
name: io.github.ictinnovations/ictexam-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your ICTExam site, e.g. https://app.ictlms.net (no trailing /api).
environmentVariables.name: ICTEXAM_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: A teacher or admin account email.
environmentVariables.name: ICTEXAM_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Path the API is mounted under. Defaults to /api (behind the usual reverse proxy). Set empty to talk to the backend port directly.
environmentVariables.name: ICTEXAM_API_PREFIX

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the write tools: parse a paper with AI (spends server AI credit), publish and unpublish exams. When false these tools are not registered at all. Leave off unless you mean it.
environmentVariables.name: ICTEXAM_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: Per request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000 (AI parsing can be slow).
environmentVariables.name: ICTEXAM_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Only for a self-signed test server.
environmentVariables.name: ICTEXAM_TLS_INSECURE
